Name: SupporterMod
Description: v0.2.0 - Phase 1 complete. The entitlement core is now wired to the server: SupporterPlugin lifecycle, the /supporter command tree, player-join claiming and the nightly reconcile job. Admin subcommands (grant, revoke, reconcile) extend CommandBase rather than AbstractPlayerCommand, because AbstractPlayerCommand requires a player and Tebex delivers purchases from the console - a player-only grant command would fail on every real purchase while working perfectly in testing. No optional positional arguments anywhere: withOptionalArg registers a named flag rendered as [--name=?], so a bare positional word is rejected as an unexpected required parameter. Startup failure is surfaced rather than swallowed - the server bundles no JDBC driver, so sqlite-jdbc unpacks a native library at first use and can fail at runtime in a way no compile check catches; if that happens every command reports the reason instead of the server booting with a silently dead supporter system that accepts grants and loses them. --- v0.1.0 - Supporter rank for The People's Server. Entitlement core only: grant, renewal, grace period and nightly expiry reconcile, backed by SQLite. Renewals extend from the existing expiry rather than from now, so buying early never costs time. Grants carrying a payment-provider transaction id are applied at most once, because Tebex retries delivery until the server acknowledges it. Nothing in this plugin touches combat, claims, power, outpost income, KOTJ scoring or the bucks economy.
